$comment: Undocumented Antigravity plugin metadata, kept outside the validated manifest. The published plugin.json schema is a closed object (additionalProperties: false) that only allows $schema, name and description, so unknown fields make `agy plugin validate --strict` fail. The official Antigravity changelog confirms the runtime surfaces a per-plugin icon and suggested prompts, but it does not publish the field names or their shape, so these entries are unverified. Promote them into plugin.json once Google documents the contract.
